purpose: Separated hull/base0/arm CFD load modelling, not controller tracking
frame: CAD body axes at reference pose, +Y up; current link-local axes for link1/2/3 wrenches
moment_reference: hull and base0 about Ob; links about original uvms_geometry link reference points, NOT shifted new-CAD rigid-body COMs

steady_schema.nu: 6-vector [body relative linear velocity; angular velocity], positive opposite the fixed-body inlet velocity
steady_schema.strict: boolean, achieved original solver criterion and no required failures
steady_schema.unsteady_mean: boolean, capped at 2500 iterations and retained only for sensitivity
steady_schema.uncertainty_wrenches_sd: 5x6 population SD across the sampled tail window; not independent measurement uncertainty
steady_schema.source: relative source paths and averaging indices

oscillation_schema.wrenches: Nx5x6 physical loads, same references as steady
oscillation_schema.total: Nx6 physical total loads about moving Ob
oscillation_schema.joint_tau: Nx3 physical torques about moving joint centres/axes
oscillation_schema.identification_mask: N booleans selecting t>one period and after ramp

steady_inputs: nu(6), with angular velocity zero for validated steady scope
prediction_contract.recomposition: rotate link wrenches and translate moments to Ob; project using original joint-chain kinematics; no independent ad-hoc torque correction

validation.training_scaling: training fold only, never held-out labels
validation.existing_data_role: retrospective development, not a new blind test
validation.dynamic_scope: fixed arm q0 with whole-domain oscillation; independent joint motion not validated
